tooltip.inspector: Displays metadata and a preview for the file selected in the tree.

listMode.title: Send the current list to RapidRAW (experimental)
listMode.desc: With RapidRAW as your editor you can turn on "Send the current list to RapidRAW" in Settings under the RAW developer choice. Opening a photo (R) then hands RapidRAW the whole list as the grid shows it right now, after filters, stacking and sorting, so RapidRAW's filmstrip and ←/→ follow the same order. RAW+JPG stacks are sent as the RAW file; videos are skipped.
listMode.selection: If several photos are selected, only the selection is sent (in grid order), with the focused photo opened first. Handy for: select your picks, press R, then select all in RapidRAW and use its export panel.
listMode.requirement: This needs a RapidRAW version that understands list hand-off. If RapidRAW cannot be found, RapidReady falls back to opening just the single photo.
